text: dsh-theme-brick 是面向 DSH Web 的暖色主题插件，通过主题服务覆盖界面颜色 token，并在设置页提供开关。它为浅色和深色模式配置石膏、纸张、黏土与暖灰色调，也调整边框、文字、品牌强调色、状态色、气泡、侧栏、滚动条和阴影。用户可在 Settings → General 关闭或重新启用主题，开关状态保存在浏览器 localStorage。适合想让 DSH Web 呈现克制暖色外观并可随时恢复默认主题的用户。

dsh-theme-brick adds a warm palette to DSH Web, covering surfaces, text, accents, and other theme colors in light and dark modes. A switch in Settings → General turns it off or on; localStorage remembers the choice. It suits users who want warm colors and an easy return to the default look.
想把 DSH 网页界面换成柔和的暖色调。
能给 DSH Web 加一个浅色和深色都协调的主题吗？
我想把界面里的冷蓝色改成石膏、陶土一类的颜色。
dsh-theme-brick 的暖色主题层：覆盖 DSH Web 的表面、文字、边框、品牌强调色、状态色、气泡、侧栏、滚动条和阴影 token，并分别设置浅色与深色值。插件加载时通过主题服务应用这组颜色。
dsh-theme-brick 的设置开关：Settings → General 中提供 Brick 主题开关。点击即可停用主题并恢复默认外观，或重新应用主题；选择会保存到浏览器 localStorage。
dsh-theme-brick 会在浏览器 localStorage 中读写 dsh-theme-brick:enabled，以跨页面重载保存主题开关状态。

A restrained, **token-only** theme layer for [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek.com/harness/) Web — warm plaster neutrals, mortar hairlines, one fired-clay accent, and a Settings on/off switch.

dsh-theme-brick README · Why Brick：The folder name says it: **bricks**. DSH's architecture is plugs-within-plugs, a wall of bricks —
each unit load-bearing and interchangeable. So the theme follows **masonry**, not decoration:

dsh-theme-brick README · Why Brick：- **面是材料** — surfaces read as limewashed plaster / paper / kiln clay, not glowing glass.
- **缝是灰缝** — borders are honest, even mortar hairlines with a warm undertone.
- **一砖一色** — a single *fired-clay / ember* accent, carried through the exact channels the product itself uses for its brand blue.
- **克制是纪律** — one `theme.overrideTokens()` call. No DOM hacking, no global CSS, no animation, no new chrome.
dsh-theme-brick README · Why Brick：Design rationale: [`DESIGN.md`](DESIGN.md) · phase plans: [`PLAN-PHASE2-LAYOUT.md`](PLAN-PHASE2-LAYOUT.md)

dsh-theme-brick README · Features：- **84 live tokens** (verified *defined + consumed*, zero-dead gate) across five phases.
- **Warm palette, both modes** — light = plaster & paper, dark = kiln & embers.
- **Settings → General on/off switch** for statically installed bundles: toggle the theme off without uninstalling; state persists in `localStorage`.
- **Composes with any other plugin** via token layers; removing restores exactly what was covered.
- **No global CSS** — the switch is drawn entirely with theme CSS variables (auto-adapts to light/dark).
dsh-theme-brick README · As a dsh bundle (recommended)：```bash
dsh-theme-brick README · From a published release / registry:：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-theme-brick

dsh-theme-brick README · New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $HOME\.dsh\plugins-dev\dsh-theme-brick -Target <repo path>：dsh plugin --profile web add "file:C:/Users/<you>/.dsh/plugins-dev/dsh-theme-brick"

dsh --profile web --dump-config   # confirm the `brick` loader entry is composed
dsh web                           # restart to activate (bundle layers compose at boot)
```

dsh-theme-brick README · New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $HOME\.dsh\plugins-dev\dsh-theme-brick -Target <repo path>：The plugin loads and applies on boot (default **on**). Open **Settings → General → Brick 主题** to toggle it
off (restores the default look) or on; the choice persists across reloads. To fully uninstall:
`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-theme-brick`.

dsh-theme-brick README · New-Item -ItemType Junction -Path $HOME\.dsh\plugins-dev\dsh-theme-brick -Target <repo path>：> **Golden triangle** for a dsh bundle: the npm `name`, the patch layer `name`, and the `client.js`
> `__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` must all be equal. This package satisfies it (`dsh-theme-brick`
> everywhere). See the [dsh plugin install guide](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/develop/basic/publish).

dsh-theme-brick README · Developing locally：```bash
node scripts/build.mjs          # src/client.js -> lib/client.js (__ModuleLoader__ bundle)
node scripts/verify-plugin.mjs  # materialize + token gate + on/off switch logic tests
node --check lib/client.js
```

dsh-theme-brick README · Package layout：```
lib/client.js         browser half (bundle; served at /plugins/dsh-theme-brick/client.js)
lib/index.js          host half (no-op loader entry)
src/client.js         readable source of truth (token map + switch); build transpiles it
cordis.patch.yml      profile patch — injects the `brick` loader entry

dsh-theme-brick README · Contributing：PRs welcome. Design decisions are recorded in `DESIGN.md` and the phase plans — please read them before
changing tokens. Road rules: override only tokens actually *consumed* by the product (the
`scripts/sweep-tokens.mjs` gate enforces it); keep every change composable and reversible; add a regression
check to `scripts/verify-plugin.mjs` when behavior changes; and respect **restraint** — no DOM hacking, no
global CSS selectors, no decorative animation.
